owners.label: Ghost Cyberware
owners.description:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for 8s, she gains 1 stacks of Optical Illusion. Max 1 stacks by default.
Optical Illusion: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by 100%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful Dodge if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove 1 stacks of Optical Illusion. This effect can be triggered up to 1 times every 0.5s.

owners.label: Function Cracking
owners.description:
When Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, or Resonance Skill - Deadlock damages an Overlord Class or Calamity Class enemy, Lucy applies Botnet Mark on them for 2 min. While Botnet Mark is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the Network Backdoor effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.


Network Backdoor

Grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for 2 min and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by 5% and Hack DMG Multiplier by 5%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain Network Backdoor, and any existing Network Backdoor effects become invalid.

owners.label: Countermeasure Program
owners.description:
The incoming Resonator gains 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
Grants all Resonators in the team Countermeasure Program for 25s.
While the effect is active, when an active Resonator in the team other than Lucy inflicts Hack - Shifting, that Resonator gains 20% All DMG Amplification.
While the effect is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lucy is attacked, Lucy grants them 30% DMG Reduction for 3s and Stagnates their attacker for 1s. This effect can only trigger up to 1 time while Countermeasure Program is active. Obtaining Countermeasure Program again resets the effective charge.
When the All DMG Amplification is effective, switching to another Resonator ends the Countermeasure Program early.

owners.label: The Moon, a Ticket, and a Dream
owners.description:
Lucy is now immune to interruptions during Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Inteference, Heavy Attack - Dual Threading, and Heavy Attack - Multi-Threading
Casting Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination increases ATK by 20% for 14s.
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target affected by Spoofing Program with direct damage, Lucy records the effect triggered and activates the corresponding Quick Action on that Resonator for 6s. The record expires when Lucy is knocked out.
Quick Action: When activated, inflict the recorded Spoofing Program effects on targets within a certain distance from the active Resonator in the team, effective once only on each target.
The following Spoofing Program effects can be recorded: Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction, Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol, Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement, Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch, and Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis. When applying Spoofing Program effects via Quick Action, only the continuous status effects are applied.

owners.label: The Blackwall, the Past, the Escape
owners.description:
While casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner and Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, Lucy's starting RAM is increased to 32.
After casting Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, deal 1 additional instance of Spectro DMG equal to 450% of Lucy's ATK, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When this instance of damage hits the target, apply all of the following Spoofing Program effects: Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction,
Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol, Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement, Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch, and Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis. Only the continuous status effects are applied.
Forte Circuit - Depths of Blackwall is enhanced: When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy has SQL, the DMG Multiplier increase is raised from 270% to 560%.

owners.label: Cyberpunk
owners.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Override from Resonance Liberation - Netrunner and Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is increased by 50%, and its Crit. DMG is increased by 100%.
The DMG Multiplier of Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement is increased by 65%.
The DMG Multiplier of Hack Response - Data Crash is increased by 65%.

owners.label: No Living Legends in Night City
owners.description: When Resonators in the team inflict Hack - Shifting, Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 20s.

owners.label: A Broken Path to Hell
owners.description:
The stack limit of Optical Illusion obtainable via Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware is increased to 2.
Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware is now enhanced: When Lucy's HP falls below 50%, she immediately gains 1 stacks of Optical Illusion upon being hit. This effect has a Cooldown of 180s. When Optical Illusion is triggered, Lucy gains a Shield equal to 150% of ATK for 10s.

owners.label: I Really Want to Stay At Your House
owners.description:
Targets with Hack - Shifting or in the Hack - Interfered state take 40% increased Heavy Attack DMG from Lucy.
Targets with Hack - Shifting or in the Hack - Interfered state take 60% increased Hack DMG from Lucy.
The Stagnation triggered by Hack Response - Data Crash now lasts for 1.5s.
